flags.summary: In a January 2025 article, Lakeshore Public Media described Blake-King as a frequent critic of how the district cut spending and reported that she had called top administrators 'carpetbaggers'.
flags.note: Second-hand description of past remarks; the article does not give the date or setting, and no response from administrators was reported. Probably context only.

sources.title: Hammond schools to restore some bus service, new board president promises restoration and elevation
